items.label: Capture the first delivery round context.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, bounded repository set, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, Evidence target, risks, and unknowns are identified before editing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-first-delivery-round, owner repo-project-control, bounded repository set repo-project-control/repo-editor/repo-backend/repo-core, active role planning-partner with documentation-authority-steward and project-control-steward responsibilities, phase target phase-flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan-2026-09-01.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard for the first delivery round plan.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Project Control test fails before the First Delivery Round Plan document and records exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because flowdoc-first-delivery-round was not linked from flowdoc-product-development-resumption and doc-flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan was not linked from the FlowDoc node.

items.label: Draft the Project Control first delivery round plan.
items.evidenceTarget: The Project Control document records authority boundary, Work context, source documents, round goal, non-goals, terminology decisions, and dispatch status.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan.md records the first delivery round as a PLAN room coordination contract and states that no real WORK room has been opened by this plan.

items.label: Define lane cards for the first delivery round.
items.evidenceTarget: The plan defines lane cards for Project Control records, Editor structure/publish, Backend gateway/database, Core document/PDF boundary, and integration evidence.
items.verificationNote: The plan defines lane-project-control-round-records, lane-editor-structure-publish, lane-backend-gateway-database, lane-core-document-pdf-boundary, and lane-integration-evidence with owner repositories, scopes, evidence targets, stop conditions, and handoff formats.

items.label: Define WORK room Kickoff Packets.
items.evidenceTarget: Every lane has a Kickoff Packet with Room Mode WORK, source of truth, owner repository, allowed scope, forbidden scope, required reading, expected output, evidence target, stop condition, and handoff format.
items.verificationNote: The plan includes one Kickoff Packet per lane and requires user approval before opening a real separate WORK room.

items.label: Record Project Control records for the first delivery round plan.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the Work, Phase, Checklist, Document, and FlowDoc Node link without product truth promotion.
items.verificationNote: Registered flowdoc-first-delivery-round, phase-flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan, checklist-flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan, doc-flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan, and the FlowDoc node document link; product repositories and map truth were intentionally not changed.

items.label: Verify the first delivery round plan gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused guard, generated read model, data validation, and full Project Control gate pass after Project Control records are registered.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: tests/flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan.test.ts, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check pass after the Project Control records are registered.
